answer.rationale: With the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, switching primary vendor or deferring past a non-auto-renewing expiry creates delivery risk that outweighs potential savings; adding a second source is valuable but does not deliver the mandated 18% cut within one decision. Renegotiating with the incumbent—benchmarking on price/payment terms and exploring a multi-year volume commitment—targets the cost mandate while preserving the stable integration and uninterrupted deliveries that memory_c1 records. memory_c4 and memory_c6 both indicate the incumbent has moved on price and terms when pressed, so I verify those two before committing.
